rows.name: for-break
rows.program: for i 0..3 { break }

rows.name: for-break-after-leaf
rows.program: for i 0..3 { acc += 1; break }

rows.name: for-break-dead-tail
rows.program: for i 0..3 { break; acc += 1 }

rows.name: for-break-dead-return
rows.program: for i 0..3 { break; return 99 }

rows.name: for-break-under-if
rows.program: for i 0..5 { if i == 2 { break }; acc += 1 }

rows.name: for-break-if-else
rows.program: for i 0..4 { if i == 2 { break } else { acc += 1 } }

rows.name: for-break-trailing-comment
rows.program: for i 0..3 { break # done }

rows.name: for-continue
rows.program: for i 0..3 { continue }

rows.name: for-continue-after-leaf
rows.program: for i 0..3 { acc += 1; continue }

rows.name: for-continue-dead-tail
rows.program: for i 0..3 { continue; acc += 1 }

rows.name: for-continue-under-if
rows.program: for i 0..4 { if i == 2 { continue }; acc += 1 }

rows.name: for-continue-if-else
rows.program: for i 0..4 { if i == 2 { continue } else { acc += 1 } }

rows.name: for-continue-last-trip
rows.program: for i 0..3 { acc += 1; if i == 2 { continue }; acc += 10 }

rows.name: for-continue-trailing-comment
rows.program: for i 0..3 { continue # again }

rows.name: while-break
rows.program: while i < 3 { i += 1; break }

rows.name: while-break-under-if
rows.program: while i < 5 { i += 1; if i == 2 { break }; acc += 1 }

rows.name: while-continue
rows.program: while i < 3 { acc += 1; i += 1; continue }

rows.name: while-continue-under-if
rows.program: while i < 4 { i += 1; if i == 2 { continue }; acc += 1 }

rows.name: while-true-break-counter
rows.program: while true { i += 1; if i == 3 { break } }; return i

rows.name: nested-inner-break
rows.program: for o 0..3 { for n 0..5 { acc += 1; break } }

rows.name: nested-inner-continue
rows.program: for o 0..3 { for n 0..2 { acc += 1; continue } }

rows.name: nested-outer-break
rows.program: for o 0..3 { for n 0..2 { acc += 1 }; break }

rows.name: for-in-while-break
rows.program: while i < 2 { for k 0..3 { acc += 1; break }; i += 1 }

rows.name: while-in-for-break
rows.program: for o 0..2 { let j = 0; while j < 3 { acc += 1; break } }

rows.name: jump-in-loop-in-helper
rows.program: return jl() where jl loops and breaks after one trip
